items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio: 3D Editor + Canvas

items.name: Meshy-6 Auto-Rig + Animate

items.why_en: Continued refinement and strong emphasis on its AI auto-rigging and animation generator, highlighted by new comprehensive guides and workflow updates this month, making 3D character animation accessible in under a minute.

items.name: Animworks: Armature Artists

items.why_en: New standalone AI auto-rigging software designed to bridge the gap for animators who don't rig, offering easy point-based rigging and Unreal export.

items.name: Poly Hammer: Character Control Rig for Blender

items.why_en: A significant update to a Blender add-on, enhancing control rig generation for MetaHuman characters with a new retargeting engine and Auto-Rig Pro support, crucial for Blender users in game development.

items.name: Zoo Tools Pro

items.why_en: Expands support for integrating third-party skeletons and building Hive rigs from existing setups (Unreal Engine, HumanIK, Unity, etc.), streamlining rigging workflows for Maya users.
